evidence_standard.workflow: SOURCE → EXTRACT → NORMALIZE → MODEL → IMPLEMENT → TEST → FORMALIZE → REPLAY → COMPARE
evidence_standard.rule: Every claim tagged; inferences never promoted to DOCUMENTED; original artifacts hash-verified
evidence_standard.verification: SHA-256 per artifact file; reproducible build via Nix/frozen lockfile; deterministic replay hash
